findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observes the bottom shelves of the reach in cooler, section 2, to have mold and soil accumulation. Clean the unit and maintain it free of accumulated soil. 
 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

Observed multiple dented cans. Can voluntarily pulled from shelf. Discussed with PIC. Ensure staff is aware of not stocking dented cans. COS.
